description: We are Applied Physics students with a interests ranging from astrophysics, computational modeling and hardware (Raspberry Pi, Arduino, Jetson Nano etc)  based projects that includes proficiency in MATLAB, LabView, C++, Java and Python amongst others.
summary: Cropaganda is an AI-assisted crop management and planning website paired with an affordable ESP32-based weather and soil quality station. Climate change has shortened the growing season and continues to shorten yields every year. Farmers around the world have to be very scientific with their crop planning, and the data needed to plan a good crop rotation cycle is hard to find. Corpaganda uses the Gemini API and NASA  Climate Data to power Fieldy, a friendly AI assistant for farmers. Farmers can ask Fieldy for the best crop rotation to preserve soil health and retain yields. Fieldy helps the farmer plan exact details from the day of seeding to harvest day, based on scientific data from NASA and the current soil quality from the weather station.
details: Cropaganda is a Crop management website that uses the power of AI to translate and simplify NASA weather data, and the ESP32-based weather station collects and stores live readings from the field. The ESP32 uses soil moisture, barometer, light, temperature, and humidity sensors to provide live readings from the field. Once stored on TigerData and displayed on the website, we compare it to NASA POWER, NASA SMAP, USDA NRCS SSURGO/STATS2GO, USGS National Map, USGS Waterdata, USGS Land Cover Database, USDA Web Soil Survey, and PRISM databases. The Gemini API powered Ai assistant, Fieldy, then uses all of these as a reference to suggest the best crop rotation and planting/harvesting times. Fieldy is also connected to Twilio and Google Calendar, which can send severe weather alerts, and the calendar can add the schedules. Our project makes it simple for farmers to access and navigate NASA’s data and manage their entire farm. We envision a world where cropaganda can help farmers farm better and make an impact worldwide.
